say:1:1322052201:1.text: Niru, has your research borne fruit?!

say:2:1322052202:1.text: No, I can only grant respite to a handful of the undead. The path to freeing the countless souls here remains long and arduous.
say:2:1322052202:1.source_cn: 不，我只能对很少一部分活死人进行“灵魂安抚”。要想让这...

say:3:1322052203:1.text: Fret not, the fractured souls of these undead are intriguing... I shall continue my research.
say:3:1322052203:1.source_cn: 别担心，这些活死人残破的灵魂很有趣……我会继续研究。

say:4:1322052204:0.text: Are these, then, the new acquaintances you wish to make known to me, Valka?
say:4:1322052204:0.source_cn: 那么……呵呵，瓦丽卡，这几位就是你想介绍的新朋友吗？

choice_prompt:6:1322052204.text: Are these, then, the new acquaintances you wish to make known to me, Valka?
choice_prompt:6:1322052204.source_cn: 那么……呵呵，瓦丽卡，这几位就是你想介绍的新朋友吗？

say:7:1322052205:1.text: Yes, a human and, oh... two familiars! You must be a mage.
say:7:1322052205:1.source_cn: 是人类和……喔，使魔！看来你是位魔法师。
say:7:1322052205:1.male: Yes, a human and, oh... two familiars! You must be a mage.
say:7:1322052205:1.female: Yes, a human and, oh... two familiars! You must be a mage.

say:8:1322052206:1.text: I've often wondered if your soul differs from that of an ordinary mortal... But tell me, what does a mage seek from me?
say:8:1322052206:1.source_cn: 真好奇你的灵魂和普通人有什么不同……呵，那么，一位魔法...
say:8:1322052206:1.male: I've often wondered if your soul differs from that of an ordinary mortal... But tell me, what does a mage seek from me?
say:8:1322052206:1.female: I've often wondered if your soul differs from that of an ordinary mortal... But tell me, what does a mage seek from me?

choice_prompt:9:1322052206.text: I've often wondered if your soul differs from that of an ordinary mortal... But tell me, what does a mage seek from me?
choice_prompt:9:1322052206.source_cn: 真好奇你的灵魂和普通人有什么不同……呵，那么，一位魔法师找我有什么事情呢？
choice_prompt:9:1322052206.male: I've often wondered if your soul differs from that of an ordinary mortal... But tell me, what does a mage seek from me?
choice_prompt:9:1322052206.female: I've often wondered if your soul differs from that of an ordinary mortal... But tell me, what does a mage seek from me?

say:10:1322052207:1.text: So you have met my wife and son. I know not what you and she discussed, but if it was of Daimon, it was likely no light conversation...
say:10:1322052207:1.source_cn: 这么说你已经见过我的妻子和儿子了。我不知道你们聊过什么...

choice_prompt:11:1322052207.text: So you have met my wife and son. I know not what you and she discussed, but if it was of Daimon, it was likely no light conversation...
choice_prompt:11:1322052207.source_cn: 这么说你已经见过我的妻子和儿子了。我不知道你们聊过什么，但如果话题是关于戴蒙的，想必不会很愉快吧……

say:12:1322052208:1.text: Ah... Yes, that does sound like Shemira. But please, don't be angry—she's just overly concerned about Daimon. When he was alive, his health was a constant struggle.
say:12:1322052208:1.source_cn: 啊……没错，确实是雪米拉会做的事情。但请别生气，她只是...

choice_prompt:13:1322052208.text: Ah... Yes, that does sound like Shemira. But please, don't be angry—she's just overly concerned about Daimon. When he was alive, his health was a constant struggle.
choice_prompt:13:1322052208.source_cn: 啊……没错，确实是雪米拉会做的事情。但请别生气，她只是过于担心戴蒙。毕竟戴蒙还活着时，他的身体实在是太令人头疼了。

say:14:1322052210:1.text: I was a military physician before my death. Later, I made certain... sacrifices that I believed were necessary, and for that, I was sentenced to die.
say:14:1322052210:1.source_cn: 我生前是个军医，后来做了些……呵呵，在我看来很有必要的...

say:15:1322052211:1.text: However, I had dabbled in gravecalling magic. Before my execution, I invoked a spell of reincarnation... For death, I've learned, is merely another form of existence.
say:15:1322052211:1.source_cn: 但我曾研究过亡灵魔法，在被处决前，我给自己用了一种亡灵...

say:16:1322052212:1.text: When I was resurrected as a Graveborn, I spent a long time in a daze. I couldn't remember anything about my past life—I had forgotten Shemira and Daimon. I didn't know Daimon had died of illness or that Shemira was nearly destroyed by grief...
say:16:1322052212:1.source_cn: 后来我的确复活成了亡灵。但很长一段时间我都浑浑噩噩，不...

say:17:1322052213:1.text: Because of my work, I was rarely by her side. I couldn't help her care for the boy, nor could I give her the security she needed. She lived in constant worry and anxiety, and Daimon's death was the final blow.
say:17:1322052213:1.source_cn: 我生前为了工作，常常不在她身边，无法和她一起照顾孩子，...

say:18:1322052214:1.text: When we reunited as Graveborn, she didn't want to experience the feeling of losing a child ever again. She devoted herself entirely to Daimon, and that obsession drove her to extremes.
say:18:1322052214:1.source_cn: 我们以亡灵的身份团聚后，她不想再一次体验失去孩子的感受...

say:19:1322052215:1.text: Shemira means no harm. All we want is a safe, quiet place where we can live peacefully as a family.
say:19:1322052215:1.source_cn: 雪米拉她并没有恶意。我们只想找个安全和安静的地方，一家...

say:21:1322052216:1.text: So, you intend to make Whiteridge your home?
say:21:1322052216:1.source_cn: 这么说，你们打算定居白山？

say:22:1322052217:1.text: Why not? It's far removed from Bantus, and I can finally conduct my research without the constant interference of those warmongering fanatics.
say:22:1322052217:1.source_cn: 为什么不呢？这里远离班题斯，我可以不必再被那些发狂的战...

say:23:1322052218:1.text: Whiteridge is quiet and serene, a place where Daimon and Shemira can heal away from the chaos of the world.
say:23:1322052218:1.source_cn: 而且白山很安静，也很平和，很适合戴蒙和雪米拉休养。

say:24:1322052219:1.text: I understand that your family means no harm, but Lady Shemira's actions have caused fear among the locals. If possible, we'd like to speak with her and resolve this peacefully.
say:24:1322052219:1.source_cn: 我理解你们一家并非歹人。但雪米拉女士的行为引起了当地生...

say:25:1322052220:1.text: Someone should speak with her, yes. I'll guide you to our temporary home, a <style="highlight">cemetery west of Cedartown</style>, near the hot springs inn.
say:25:1322052220:1.source_cn: 当然，是该有人劝劝她。我带你们去家里——临时的家里——...

say:26:1322052221:1.text: Shemira is usually calm and level-headed when Daimon is not involved at least.
say:26:1322052221:1.source_cn: 不涉及到戴蒙时，雪米拉还是很冷静的，呵呵……

choice:13:0:1.text: What's going on with your family?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你们一家到底是什么情况？
choice:13:0:1.male: What's going on with your family?
choice:13:0:1.female: What's going on with your family?

say:28:1322052209:1.text: Love has its own kind of balance. If something is lost, you're forced to compensate for it, drawing from whatever you can to make up the difference.
say:28:1322052209:1.source_cn: 爱似乎也有一种守恒，有缺失的部分，就要从别的地方找到弥补……

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 雪米拉的母爱有点夸张啊……
